finding.summary: Controller never trips when BMS returns stale/frozen values. Real cell 4 reached 3795 mV (>3650 mV limit) but controller log shows frozen cells=[3285,3288,3291,3294] mV and frozen tick=7073, trip=off for entire 3000 ms window -> FAIL no_trip. Root cause: controller.py trusts cell voltages without checking freshness counter (reg 10 tick) or other liveness, so frozen Modbus replies blind it to real over-voltage. Healthy baseline with same drift trips in 188 ms, proving fault-dependent failure.

verdict.code_location: main() poll loop in pi/controller.py: regs=read_registers(...); cells=regs[0:4]; vmax check — uses cell voltages directly without checking regs[10] tick freshness; fail-safe only on ModbusError count>=5
evidence: stale on, drift 500: FAIL no_trip, real max 3795-3795mV >3650 limit, controller log frozen cells=[3285,3288,3291,3294] tick=7338 trip=off for entire window
healthy same drift 500: PASS latency 75.9ms TRIP cell 4 at 3794mV, proving fault-dependent
controller prints tick but never checks it; stale replies have valid CRC so errors counter stays 0 and lost-comm trip never fires
fix_requirements: Track regs[10] tick freshness every poll: store last tick and timestamp
Trip fail-safe if tick frozen (unchanged) for e.g. >=500ms or >=N consecutive polls, same as lost-communication handling
Handle tick wrap correctly and require strictly increasing tick within timeout
Do not reset comm-error counter on stale/frozen data; stale must trigger TRIP, not normal operation
verdict.root_cause: Controller trusts cell voltages without checking freshness counter (reg 10 tick) or other liveness. Frozen Modbus replies with valid CRC blind it to real over-voltage; error-counter fail-safe only covers timeouts/CRC, so stale never trips.

patch: Track regs[10] tick freshness every poll. Any change (tick != last_tick) counts as fresh which handles 16-bit wrap. Frozen tick increments stale_count and comm-error counter (never reset on stale), trips fail-safe after >=3 frozen polls OR >=0.5s frozen, and blocks re-arm while stale. Healthy link with incrementing tick never trips.

verification.note: controller was already tripped before the over-voltage (safe state)
